from lxml import etree
import re

with open\('/home/shikha/Main/Coding/Prototype 7/ESR-102001.xml', 'rb'\) as f:
    content = f.read\(\)

# Remove DOCTYPE/entity declarations to avoid external entity issues
content_clean = re.sub\(rb'<!DOCTYPE[^[]*\\[.*?\\]>', b'', content, flags=re.DOTALL\)
content_clean = re.sub\(rb'<!DOCTYPE[^>]*>', b'', content_clean\)

# Add namespace declarations if needed
# Try parsing with recover=True
parser = etree.XMLParser\(recover=True, resolve_entities=False\)
root = etree.fromstring\(content_clean, parser=parser\)

def show_tree\(el, depth=0, max_depth=3\):
    tag = etree.QName\(el.tag\).localname if el.tag else el.tag
    attrs = {etree.QName\(k\).localname: v for k, v in el.attrib.items\(\)}
    print\('  ' * depth + f'<{tag}> {attrs}'\)
    if depth < max_depth:
        children = list\(el\)
        for child in children[:6]:
            show_tree\(child, depth+1, max_depth\)
        if len\(children\) > 6:
            print\('  ' * \(depth+1\) + f'... \({len\(children\)} total children\)'\)

show_tree\(root, max_depth=3\)
")
